say:1:1735405001:1.text: "This is the Arcane Affairs Office. Surely using magic here is perfectly normal?"
say:1:1735405001:1.source_cn: “办公室名字都叫魔法事务司了，在这里使用魔法也是很正常...
say:1:1735405001:1.male: "This is the Arcane Affairs Office. Surely using magic here is perfectly normal?"
say:1:1735405001:1.female: "This is the Arcane Affairs Office. Surely using magic here is perfectly normal?"

say:2:1735405002:1.text: That's a common assumption, and it's precisely why our office is so often the site of mishaps.
say:2:1735405002:1.source_cn: 阁下，正是因为这样想的人太多了，魔法事务司的办公室才屡...
say:2:1735405002:1.male: That's a common assumption, and it's precisely why our office is so often the site of mishaps.
say:2:1735405002:1.female: That's a common assumption, and it's precisely why our office is so often the site of mishaps.

say:3:1735405003:1.text: Being a mage yourself, you should know the risks that come with using magic. Misfires, loss of control, explosions. The list goes on.
say:3:1735405003:1.source_cn: 同为魔法师，您应该也清楚，只要使用魔法，就有出错、失控...
say:3:1735405003:1.male: Being a mage yourself, you should know the risks that come with using magic. Misfires, loss of control, explosions. The list goes on.
say:3:1735405003:1.female: Being a mage yourself, you should know the risks that come with using magic. Misfires, loss of control, explosions. The list goes on.

say:4:1735405004:1.text: I once had a colleague who insisted on testing a new spell in here.
say:4:1735405004:1.source_cn: 曾经有一位同僚对此不以为然，坚持在工区研究某项新兴魔法。
say:4:1735405004:1.male: I once had a colleague who insisted on testing a new spell in here.
say:4:1735405004:1.female: I once had a colleague who insisted on testing a new spell in here.

say:5:1735405005:1.text: And... he ended up blowing up half of the office. The cost of repairs left us financially strapped for three years straight.
say:5:1735405005:1.source_cn: 结果……魔法事务司被他整整炸掉了大半，修复工作导致连续...
say:5:1735405005:1.male: And... he ended up blowing up half of the office. The cost of repairs left us financially strapped for three years straight.
say:5:1735405005:1.female: And... he ended up blowing up half of the office. The cost of repairs left us financially strapped for three years straight.

say:6:1735405006:1.text: To prevent it from happening again, we set up a detection spell that sounds an alarm whenever magic is used.
say:6:1735405006:1.source_cn: 鉴于过去的惨痛教训，我们于是在事务司内设置了规则魔法，...
say:6:1735405006:1.male: To prevent it from happening again, we set up a detection spell that sounds an alarm whenever magic is used.
say:6:1735405006:1.female: To prevent it from happening again, we set up a detection spell that sounds an alarm whenever magic is used.

say:7:1735405007:1.text: Since you don't work here, the penalty doesn't apply to you.
say:7:1735405007:1.source_cn: 您并非事务司的成员，这次的惩罚就暂时算了。
say:7:1735405007:1.male: Since you don't work here, the penalty doesn't apply to you.
say:7:1735405007:1.female: Since you don't work here, the penalty doesn't apply to you.

say:8:1735405008:1.text: But, please allow me to stress this once more: no magic is to be used within the Arcane Affairs Office.
say:8:1735405008:1.source_cn: 但阁下，请允许我再次强调：魔法事务司内，禁止使用魔法。
say:8:1735405008:1.male: But, please allow me to stress this once more: no magic is to be used within the Arcane Affairs Office.
say:8:1735405008:1.female: But, please allow me to stress this once more: no magic is to be used within the Arcane Affairs Office.
